cli.usage:
Usage: sdlc <command> [--json]
  Through the API (needs sdlc login, or SDLC_API_URL and SDLC_API_TOKEN in CI):
    sdlc login [--api-url <https://...>] [--token-stdin]
    sdlc logout
    sdlc whoami
    sdlc intent create|list|show …   (run sdlc intent for details)
    sdlc gate approve|reject|request-changes <G> <INT-…> …   (run sdlc gate for details)
    sdlc escalation list|show|ack|decide …   (run sdlc escalation for details)
    sdlc ai-record show|set …   (run sdlc ai-record for details)
    sdlc spec link|list <INT-…> …   (run sdlc spec for details)
    sdlc plan submit|list|show <INT-…> …   (run sdlc plan for details)
    sdlc run list <INT-…>, sdlc run kill <run ID|INT-…>   (the kill switch; run sdlc run for details)
    sdlc cost report …   (run sdlc cost for details)
    sdlc metrics gates …   (gate waiting times; run sdlc metrics for details)
    sdlc token create|list|revoke …   (your own API tokens; run sdlc token for details)
    sdlc admin project|user|identity|role|config|tenant-admin|token|agent …   (admins; run sdlc admin for details)
    sdlc audit verify   (tenant admins)
  Operator commands on the server (need SDLC_DB_URL, application role platform_app):
    sdlc ops …   (run sdlc ops for details)
cli.login.usage:
Usage: sdlc login [--api-url <https://...>] [--token-stdin] [--json]
  Asks for your personal API token (sdlc_pat_…) without showing it, or reads it from standard input with --token-stdin. Never put the token on the command line. --api-url is needed the first time; http:// is accepted only for this machine (127.0.0.1, localhost).
cli.login.url_required: Give the API address with --api-url, for example --api-url https://sdlc.example.internal.
cli.login.no_terminal: Standard input is not a terminal. Pipe the token in with --token-stdin; never put it on the command line.
cli.login.stdin_is_terminal: --token-stdin reads a pipe, not the terminal: typing there would show the token. Run sdlc login without --token-stdin to get a hidden prompt.
cli.login.token_invalid: This is not a personal API token: it must start with sdlc_pat_ and have 52 characters. Nothing was saved.
cli.login.aborted: The input was cancelled or too long. Nothing was saved.
cli.login.done: Logged in as {name} <{email}> in tenant {tenant} at {api_url}. The token is saved in {path} (readable only by you).
cli.login.env_overrides: Note: SDLC_API_TOKEN is set in this shell, so commands use it instead of the saved login.
cli.logout.done: The token is revoked on the server and the saved login is deleted on this machine.
cli.logout.not_revoked: The saved login is deleted on this machine, but the token could not be revoked on the server: it stays valid until it expires. Revoke it with sdlc token revoke from another login, or ask a tenant admin.
cli.logout.none: There is no saved login on this machine.
cli.token.usage:
Usage (your own personal API tokens, through the API):
  sdlc token create --name <token-name> [--days <1-365>] [--json]   (the token is shown once)
  sdlc token list [--json]
  sdlc token revoke --id <token-id> [--json]
cli.token.for_other_user: This token belongs to another person and lasts at most 7 days. Give it to them once, through a safe channel. They must create their own token with sdlc token create, then revoke this one with sdlc token revoke.
cli.audit.usage: Usage: sdlc audit verify [--json]   (tenant admins; the operator's check on the server is sdlc ops audit verify)
cli.not_logged_in: You are not logged in. Run sdlc login --api-url <address>, or set SDLC_API_URL and SDLC_API_TOKEN (CI only).
cli.env.incomplete: Set both SDLC_API_URL and SDLC_API_TOKEN, or neither (then the saved login of sdlc login is used).
cli.env.token_invalid: SDLC_API_TOKEN is not a personal API token (sdlc_pat_…, 52 characters).
cli.tls_disabled: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 turns off certificate checks. The sdlc command never runs without them: unset it, and add your company CA with NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS instead.
cli.api_url.invalid: The API address is not a valid http(s) URL.
cli.api_url.insecure: The API address must use https://. http:// is accepted only for this machine (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]).
cli.api_url.credentials: The API address must not contain a user name or password.
cli.api_url.query: The API address must not contain a query (?) or a fragment (#).
cli.credentials.no_config_dir: No folder for the saved login: set HOME or XDG_CONFIG_HOME to an absolute path.
cli.credentials.unsafe_mode: {path} can be read by other users. Run chmod 600 {path}, then log in again: the token may have been read.
cli.credentials.not_a_file: {path} is not a regular file. Delete it and run sdlc login again.
cli.credentials.not_owner: {path} belongs to another user. Delete it and run sdlc login again.
cli.credentials.malformed: {path} cannot be read. Run sdlc login again.
cli.api.http_status: The API answered with HTTP status {status} and no readable error.
cli.api.login_again: Your token is missing, expired or revoked. Get a new one (sdlc token create from another login, or ask a tenant admin), then run sdlc login.
cli.api.network: The API cannot be reached. Check the address, the network and the certificate (add a company CA with NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS).
cli.api.timeout: The API did not answer in time. Try again later.
cli.api.redirect: The API answered with a redirect. The sdlc command never follows redirects, so your token is not sent to another address: check the API address.
cli.api.too_large: The API answer is too large. Check the API address.
cli.api.malformed: The API answer has an unexpected format. The API and this sdlc command may have different versions.

comment.reply.syntax_gate_missing: The command needs a gate, for example `/approve G3`.
comment.reply.syntax_gate_invalid: The gate is not valid. Use a gate code from G1 to G8, for example `/approve G3`.
comment.reply.syntax_unexpected_text: `/approve` takes only the gate, for example `/approve G3`. Nothing was recorded. Write other text on the next line, or in another comment.
comment.reply.syntax_reason_missing: `/reject` and `/request-changes` need a reason after the gate: a reason code, a sentence, or both. Nothing was recorded.
comment.reply.syntax_decision_missing: `/decide` needs a decision: resume, modify, roll-back, terminate or escalate. Nothing was recorded.
comment.reply.syntax_decision_invalid: The decision is not valid. Use resume, modify, roll-back, terminate or escalate. Nothing was recorded.
comment.reply.usage:
Commands (on the first line of a new comment):
- `/approve G<n>`
- `/reject G<n> [reason code] <reason>`
- `/request-changes G<n> [reason code] <reason>`

Valid reason codes: {codes}. A reason code other than `other` may stand alone; without a reason code, the platform records `other`. The reason itself stays in this comment; the platform stores only a link to it.
comment.reply.usage_escalation:
Escalation commands (on the first line of a new comment):
- `/ack [ESC-YYYY-NNNN]`
- `/decide [ESC-YYYY-NNNN] <resume|modify|roll-back|terminate|escalate> [reason code] [reason]`

The escalation code may be left out when the intent has only one escalation that is not decided. Valid reason codes: {codes}. The reason stays in this comment; the platform stores only a link to it.
comment.reply.user_not_linked: {gate}: nothing was recorded. Your GitHub account is not linked to an active platform user. Ask the platform admin to link it.
comment.reply.intent_not_linked: {gate}: nothing was recorded. No open intent is linked to this issue or pull request.
comment.reply.intent_ambiguous: {gate}: nothing was recorded. More than one open intent is linked to this issue or pull request. Use the CLI with the intent code instead.
comment.reply.intent_not_found: {gate}: nothing was recorded. You have no role in the project of this intent.
comment.reply.forbidden: {gate}: nothing was recorded. Your role in this project does not allow this action.
comment.reply.gate_not_supported: {gate}: this gate cannot be decided by a comment command. G1, G2 and G3 can, G4 to G6 when they wait for a person or within the block window of a gate the platform passed, G7 (`/reject` or `/request-changes` only) and G8 when it waits for the release approval.
comment.reply.gate_input_missing: {gate}: the gate has nothing to decide on yet. Link a spec before G2, submit a plan before G3.
comment.reply.gate_not_current: {gate}: the intent is not waiting at this gate, so nothing was recorded. The last status comment shows its current gate. A gate the platform passed can still be rejected or sent back until its block window closes; it cannot be approved again.
comment.reply.plan_refused: {gate}: an agent run went outside this plan, so it cannot be approved again and nothing was recorded. Submit a new plan; G3 then waits for your approval (HITL).
comment.reply.g7_use_pr_review: {gate}: approve the pull request with a GitHub review (**Approve**) instead; nothing was recorded. `/reject G7` and `/request-changes G7` are accepted.
comment.reply.project_not_active: {gate}: the project is archived or not active.
comment.reply.config_invalid: {gate}: the stored project configuration is not valid. Ask the platform operator to fix it.
comment.reply.escalation_not_found: {gate}: nothing was recorded. No escalation that is not decided matches this intent. Name the escalation code, for example `/ack ESC-2026-0001`.
comment.reply.escalation_ambiguous: {gate}: nothing was recorded. This intent has more than one escalation that is not decided. Name the escalation code, for example `/ack ESC-2026-0001`.
comment.reply.escalation_forbidden: {gate}: nothing was recorded. Only the owner, the backup owner (once the escalation reached them) or governance may act on this escalation, and never a producer of the change.
comment.reply.escalation_not_open: {gate}: nothing was recorded. The escalation is already decided or closed.
comment.reply.escalation_already_acknowl: {gate}: nothing was recorded. The escalation is already acknowledged. Decide it with `/decide`.
comment.reply.escalation_decision_not_al: {gate}: nothing was recorded. This decision is not allowed here, for example governance cannot escalate further.
comment.reply.kill_forbidden: Not stopped: you do not hold a role that may use the kill switch on this project (config `access.kill_roles`: by default Person A, Person B and governance).
comment.reply.kill_no_active_run: Not stopped: the intent has no run that is queued or under way.

escalation.notice.reminder: **Reminder: escalation {code}** is not acknowledged yet. {mentions}: acknowledge it with `/ack {code}` by {due}. Otherwise it moves to the next owner.
escalation.notice.step_changed: **Escalation {code}** moved to the {step} step. {mentions}: acknowledge it with `/ack {code}` by {due}.

escalation.notice.incident_due: **Escalation {code}** (critical) passed its resolve deadline. Start the incident process (handbook Chapter 6 §6.7). {mentions}
escalation.notice.nobody: Nobody holds this role on the project yet
escalation.notice.footer: _Automatic notice of the SDLC platform. The explanation stays in this issue; the platform stores codes and links only. No answer never means "go ahead": the work stays frozen._
intent.status.submitted: **{code}** was submitted and waits at **G1** ({gate_name}). {mentions}: decide with `/approve G1`, `/reject G1 <reason>` or `/request-changes G1 <reason>`.
intent.status.advanced: **{code}**: {previous_gate} was approved by {deciders}. The intent now waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). {mentions}: decide with `/approve {gate}`, `/reject {gate} <reason>` or `/request-changes {gate} <reason>`.
intent.status.advanced_platform: **{code}**: {previous_gate} was approved by {deciders}. The intent now waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}), which the platform checks.
intent.status.rejected: **{code}** was rejected at **{gate}** by {deciders} (reason code `{reason}`). The intent is closed.
intent.status.changes_requested: **{code}**: {deciders} requested changes at **{gate}** (reason code `{reason}`). Update the input of the gate, then decide again. {mentions}
intent.status.hotl_passed: **{code}**: the platform passed **{previous_gate}** (HOTL): its conditions hold. The intent now waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). {mentions}: until **{window_end}** you can still block {previous_gate} with `/reject {previous_gate} <reason>` or `/request-changes {previous_gate} <reason>`.
intent.status.returned: **{code}**: {deciders} requested changes at **{gate}** within its block window (reason code `{reason}`). The intent went back from {previous_gate} to **{gate}** ({gate_name}). Update the input of the gate; it then passes again or waits for a person. {mentions}
intent.status.ai_record_refused:
**{code}** cannot enter **G1** ({gate_name}) yet: the project AI record check failed (reason code `{reason}`: `ai_record_missing` means the project has no AI record; `data_class_not_allowed` means the record does not allow the intent's data class). {mentions}: create or update the project AI record. The intent continues when the record allows it.

Until the client has answered in writing, client data is handled only as `client_restricted` (handbook Ch.2 Rule 3).
intent.status.g4_refused: **{code}** cannot start its run at **G4** ({gate_name}) yet: a G4 check failed (reason code `{reason}`). {mentions}: fix the cause (the agent register or `run.agent_key`, the agent's instructions file, the project AI record, the approved spec or plan, or the budget). The platform checks G4 again on its own.
intent.status.blocked: **{code}** was blocked at **G4** ({gate_name}) (reason code `{reason}`): its risk tier or data class allows no agent run (autonomy L0). The agent never runs, and the intent is closed. {mentions}
intent.status.run_proposed: **{code}** waits at **G4** ({gate_name}) for approval of its run: agent `{agent}`, base commit `{base_sha}`. {mentions}: decide with `/approve G4`, `/reject G4 <reason>` or `/request-changes G4 <reason>`. A new commit on the default branch or a changed agent makes a new proposal and voids earlier approvals.
intent.status.agent_recertification_due: **{code}**: its run uses agent `{agent}`, whose recertification is overdue (handbook Ch.20 §20.8). The run is not blocked. {mentions}: recertify the agent.
intent.status.run_started: **{code}**: G4 is passed. The platform starts the agent run. {mentions}
intent.status.run_finished: **{code}**: the agent run ended. The intent now waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}), where the platform checks the file scope and the budget. {mentions}
intent.status.run_failed: **{code}**: the agent run failed or was stopped. The intent is paused until a person decides on the escalation. {mentions}
intent.status.run_killed: **{code}**: the agent run was stopped with the kill switch. The platform stops the sandbox and revokes the run's keys and tokens; an escalation was raised for the review, and the intent stays frozen until a person decides. {mentions}: decide on the escalation with `/decide <resume|terminate> [reason_code] [reason]`: `resume` starts a new run after G4, `terminate` closes the intent.
intent.status.run_terminated: **{code}**: the escalation of its last run was decided `terminate`. The intent is closed.
intent.status.run_not_started: **{code}**: the agent run could not start (for example the budget is used up, or the run proposal changed). The intent is back at **G4** ({gate_name}), where the platform decides again. {mentions}
intent.status.proposal_ready: **{code}**: the agent run (autonomy L1) ended with a proposal only. The platform stored it as evidence; no code was pushed. The intent is paused at **G4** ({gate_name}) while Person A takes the proposal forward. {mentions}
intent.status.run_resumed: **{code}**: the escalation of the last run allows a new run. The intent is back at **G4** ({gate_name}). {mentions}
intent.status.budget_warning: **{code}**: the agent run has used {percent} % of its budget limit (warning share `budget.warn_percent`). {mentions}: check the spend. At the stop share (`budget.stop_percent`) the platform stops the run, and G5 raises an escalation.
intent.status.scope_returned: **{code}**: the agent run changed files outside the approved plan (reason code `{reason}`). G5 failed, and the intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). {mentions}: submit a **new** plan. G3 is now HITL at every risk tier, and the plan the run went outside of cannot be approved again. The run's diff is kept as evidence.
intent.status.g5_breach: **{code}**: G5 ({gate_name}) found a breach in the agent run (reason code `{reason}`). The intent is paused, and an escalation was raised. {mentions}: decide on the escalation with `/decide <resume|modify|terminate> [reason_code] [reason]`: `resume` starts a new run after G4 (a budget increase only through the API), `modify` takes the intent back to G3, `terminate` closes it.
intent.status.g5_returned: **{code}**: the escalation of its G5 breach was decided `modify` or `roll_back`: the intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). G3 is now HITL at every risk tier. {mentions}: change the plan, or approve the same plan again. The run's diff is kept as evidence.
intent.status.terminated: **{code}**: the escalation of its G5 breach was decided `terminate`. The intent is closed. The run's diff is kept as evidence.
intent.status.spec_changed: **{code}**: its spec changed. The file at the head of the default branch differs from the spec that was checked, or a new spec was linked. The platform links the new version; the intent now waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}); it was at {previous_gate}. Approvals of the old spec no longer count. {mentions}: check the new spec at G2.
intent.status.spec_unavailable: **{code}**: its spec cannot be read at the head of the default branch (the file was removed or renamed, is not a file, is larger than 256 KiB, or is not UTF-8 text). The intent waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). {mentions}: restore the file, or link a spec with `sdlc spec link`.
intent.status.plan_changed: **{code}**: a new plan was submitted after G3. The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}); it was at {previous_gate}. Approvals of the old plan no longer count. {mentions}: check the new plan at G3.
intent.status.plan_resubmit_needed: **{code}**: the plan file `.sdlc/plans/{code}.yaml` at the head of the default branch is no longer the submitted plan (it changed, was removed, or cannot be read). The intent waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}) and does not move on. {mentions}: submit the plan again with `sdlc plan submit {code}`. Whoever submits a plan never approves it at G3.
intent.status.pr_opened: **{code}**: the platform pushed the agent's checked changes to the agent branch and opened a pull request. The intent waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}) for CI. {mentions}
intent.status.g6_publish_stopped: **{code}**: the platform could not push the agent's changes or open the pull request (for example the run changed nothing, or someone else changed the agent branch). The intent is paused at **{gate}** ({gate_name}), and a `technical` escalation was raised. {mentions}: decide on the escalation with `/decide <resume|modify|terminate> [reason_code] [reason]`: `resume` starts a new run after G4 (restore or delete a changed agent branch first), `modify` takes the intent back to G3, `terminate` closes it.
intent.status.g6_returned: **{code}**: the escalation at G6 was decided `modify` or `roll_back`: the intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). G3 is now HITL at every risk tier. {mentions}: change the plan, or approve the same plan again.
intent.status.g6_terminated: **{code}**: the escalation at G6 was decided `terminate`. The intent is closed. The run's diff is kept as evidence; close the pull request if one is open.
pr.title: {code}: changes of the agent run {run_short}
pr.body:
## Description

Changes made by the platform's agent for intent **{code}**, run `{run_id}`. The platform checked them at gate G5 (file scope against the approved plan, agent instruction files, budget) before it pushed them.

## Links

- Task / intent: {code}{issue}
- Run ID: `{run_id}`
- Agent: `{agent}` version `{agent_version}`, model `{model}`, autonomy {autonomy}
- Approved plan: SHA-256 `{plan_sha256}`
- Diff checked at G5: SHA-256 `{diff_sha256}`
- Related design doc: none (agent change)

## AI disclosure

- [ ] No AI used
- [ ] AI wrote **part** of this change (list below)
- [x] AI wrote **most / all** of this change

Human review (ticked **only by the reviewer**, when approving — never by the author or the AI):

- [ ] A human reviewed every file — reviewer:

AI tools used: agent `{agent}` (OpenHands) through the SDLC platform

Parts written by AI: every file in this pull request.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover **every** acceptance criterion (AC) of the task
- [ ] Lint, type check and tests pass in CI (gate G6)
- [x] Only files in the approved plan were changed (checked by the platform at G5)
- [ ] No secrets, no real client data
- [ ] Related docs updated if user-visible behaviour changed

Changes outside the plan: none (G5 refuses them).

## Points for the reviewer

The agent wrote every file: review all of them. The platform filled this description from codes only. Decide the gates with comments on the intent's issue.

<!-- sdlc:intent={code} run={run_id} -->
intent.status.ci_retry: **{code}**: CI failed on the pull request of the agent run (reason code `{reason}`). The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}): the platform starts a new run on top of the pushed commit, and the agent is told to fix the failing checks. {mentions}
intent.status.ci_returned: **{code}**: CI failed again and no retry is left (configuration `run.g6_ci_retries`). The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}), which is now HITL at every risk tier. {mentions}: check the plan (and the spec); approve the same plan again or submit a changed one. The pull request stays open.
intent.status.g6_decision: **{code}**: CI passed on the pull request. Gate **{gate}** ({gate_name}) needs a person's decision (the risk tier, a security finding at the configured severity, or findings the platform cannot read). {mentions}: review the checks and the findings, then decide with `/approve G6`, `/reject G6 <reason>` or `/request-changes G6 <reason>`.
intent.status.g6_escalated: **{code}**: G6 ({gate_name}) stopped (a CI timeout, the pull request was closed, merged or changed by someone else, or a critical security finding). The intent is paused, and an escalation was raised. {mentions}: decide on the escalation with `/decide <resume|modify|terminate> [reason_code] [reason]`.
intent.status.g6_resumed: **{code}**: the escalation at G6 was decided, or the pull request changed. The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}), where the platform reads CI again. {mentions}
intent.status.g7_review_needed: **{code}**: the pull request of the agent run waits for review at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). {mentions}: review the pull request on GitHub and submit a review: **Approve**, or **Request changes**. Only reviews of the latest commit count; the author of the intent and the person who allowed the run never count. Reject with `/reject G7 <reason>`.
intent.status.g7_changes_requested: **{code}**: {deciders} requested changes at **{previous_gate}** (reason code `{reason}`). The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}): the platform starts a new run on top of the pushed commit, and the agent gets the feedback of that review or comment. The approvals of the pushed commit no longer count. {mentions}
intent.status.g7_merge_ready: **{code}**: the approvals of the pull request at **{gate}** ({gate_name}) are complete. {mentions}: merge the pull request on GitHub. The platform never merges; it moves on to G8 when the approved commit is merged.
intent.status.g7_escalated: **{code}**: G7 ({gate_name}) stopped: the pull request was closed, changed by someone other than the platform, or merged before its approvals were complete (or by an account that may not merge it). The intent is paused, and an escalation was raised. {mentions}: decide on the escalation with `/decide <resume|modify|roll-back|terminate> [reason_code] [reason]`.
intent.status.g7_returned: **{code}**: G7 sent the intent back to **{gate}** ({gate_name}) (a rejection, reason code `{reason}`, or a `modify` or `roll_back` decision). G3 is now HITL at every risk tier. {mentions}: change the plan, or approve the same plan again. The pull request stays open; the next run continues from its last commit.
intent.status.g7_resumed: **{code}**: the escalation at G7 was decided, or the pull request changed. The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}), where the platform reads the pull request again. {mentions}
intent.status.g7_terminated: **{code}**: the escalation at G7 was decided `terminate`. The intent is closed. Close the pull request if it is still open; revert a merged change on the default branch yourself.
intent.status.merged: **{code}**: the approved pull request was merged. G7 passed, and the intent now waits at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). {mentions}
intent.status.g8_review_needed: **{code}** waits for the release approval at **{gate}** ({gate_name}). The platform built the Evidence Pack (`sdlc evidence show {code}`); the approval is bound to its release hash. {mentions}: check the pack and the release record (template T14), then approve with `/approve G8`, or reject with `/reject G8 <reason>`. The author of the intent, the people who allowed its runs and the plan submitters never approve.{client_note}
intent.status.g8_client_note: **Client disclosure:** this project uses the client's own disclosure format. The PM/BrSE writes the note from the project AI record ({record_ref}); approving G8 confirms that the client's note is ready.
intent.status.g8_changes_requested: **{code}**: {deciders} requested changes at **{gate}** (reason code `{reason}`). The change is already merged: a fix needs a new intent. The intent stays at G8; approvals given before this request no longer count. {mentions}
intent.status.g8_refused: **{code}**: **{gate}** ({gate_name}) cannot pass: the Evidence Pack has no client AI disclosure note (reason code `{reason}`: the project AI record is missing). {mentions}: save the project AI record (`sdlc ai-record set`); G8 checks again.
intent.status.g8_escalated: **{code}**: G8 ({gate_name}) stopped: a stored evidence file failed its hash check while the release pack was built (a possible tampering). The intent is paused, and a `security` escalation was raised. {mentions}: decide on the escalation with `/decide <resume|terminate> [reason_code] [reason]`.
intent.status.g8_resumed: **{code}**: the escalation at G8 was decided `resume`. The intent is back at **{gate}** ({gate_name}); the platform builds the Evidence Pack again. {mentions}
intent.status.g8_terminated: **{code}**: the escalation at G8 was decided `terminate`. The intent is closed without a release; the pack is not sealed.
intent.status.released: **{code}**: G8 passed ({deciders} approved the release). The platform sealed the Evidence Pack, and the intent is closed (`done`).

  build makes a new version only when the recorded data changed. export prints the Markdown file (or the JSON manifest with --manifest) after checking its SHA-256; --output saves it to a new file (mode 600, never overwritten). Default version: the latest.
